name: better-chatbot
title: better-chatbot

name: claudemind
title: ClaudeMind (Clinde)
manual: use its MCP server manager to add a server

name: deepchat
title: DeepChat
manual: Settings > MCP > add a stdio server

name: gptme
title: gptme
manual: in ~/.config/gptme/config.toml set enabled = true under [mcp] and add a [[mcp.servers]] table with name = "om", enabled = true, command and args as below

name: hyperchat
title: HyperChat
manual: on the MCP page, add a third-party MCP server

name: jetbrains-ai-assistant
title: JetBrains AI Assistant
manual: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Model Context Protocol (MCP) > Add, level Global

name: langbot
title: LangBot
manual: WebUI: Plugin Management > MCP Management > Add > Local (stdio), then bind it in the pipeline (its stdio servers run in its sandbox, where om's path must resolve)

name: langflow
title: Langflow
manual: Settings > MCP Servers > Add MCP Server > STDIO

name: lm-studio
title: LM Studio
manual: Program tab (right sidebar) > Install > Edit mcp.json, and add it under mcpServers

name: lobehub
title: LobeHub (desktop)
manual: Settings > Skills > Skill Store > Custom > Add custom skill (STDIO), then enable it in each agent's Skills (desktop app only)

name: mcp-bundler
title: MCP Bundler (macOS)
manual: main view > Add new STDIO MCP server

name: mcp-client-cli
title: mcp-client-cli
manual: add it under mcpServers in ~/.llm/config.json (a commented JSON file om does not rewrite; it needs systemPrompt and llm when new)

name: mcphub-nvim
title: MCPHub.nvim
note: the default path; a setup({config=...}) elsewhere needs om install --mcp-config

name: mcpjam
title: MCPJam Inspector
manual: Servers tab > Add server > STDIO (desktop or npx build)

name: memex
title: Workshop Desktop (formerly Memex)
manual: Settings > MCP Servers > Add Custom Server

name: msty-studio
title: Msty Studio
manual: Toolbox > Tools > Add New Tool > STDIO

name: octomind
title: Octomind
note: a file of its own (mcp-*.toml loads last); bound to the developer:general role
content:
# om: observational memory (om install octomind)
[[mcp.servers]]
name = "om"
type = "stdio"
command = "$OM"
args = ["mcp", "--harness", "$HARNESS"]
auto_bind = ["developer:general"]

name: oterm
title: oterm
note: restart oterm after installing; with OTERM_DATA_DIR set, use om install --mcp-config $OTERM_DATA_DIR/config.json

name: qoder
title: Qoder IDE
manual: user icon > Qoder IDE Settings > MCP > My Servers > + Add

name: recursechat
title: RecurseChat
manual: Model page > New Model > New MCP Model
